description: This file implements the GrainRuntime class, which provides core runtime services for grains in Orleans, including managing grain activation, storage, timers, and context validation.

classes.name: GrainRuntime
classes.description: Implements the IGrainRuntime interface, managing grain lifecycle and runtime services.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the given grain context when idle, with a specified reason.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation of a grain context for a specified duration, if supported.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage for a grain's state, wrapped in a StateStorageBridge.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Validates the provided grain context, throwing exceptions if invalid or null.
